_help: Emergency scenario (ACADEMY_SPEC E, step 19; format: academy/scenario.py). runs_on sim: only the simulator on this PC. setup + prep = the normal situation before the emergency (prep steps like a lesson: do / hint / check). event = after after_s seconds: faults = SIMULATOR faults (compass, gps_spoof, slam, joy_break, gps_fail: the simulated AURIX reacts with its own code), hazard = an object the ACADEMY draws (ais / shallow / swimmer; the academy never plays the gateway), show = an alarm the ground station would show (academy picture only); say = what the trainee is told; wait_for = the faults are in but the emergency (say + the reaction clock) starts only once the simulator shows this (e.g. its alarm); clear_after_s = the simulator faults end by themselves after that long. react.any = the right reactions (any one of them; each a list of conditions on the simulator state, in_x / in_y = the trainee's stick, delta_ge / delta_le / adelta_ge = a turn since the event); good_s = full marks, max_s = too late. forbid = actions that fail at once. observe_s = how long the outcome is watched; outcome.min_m = the closest a hazard may come (shallow: metres from the edge). after = follow-up steps (untimed). right = the right action (debrief), debrief = the explanation. A new scenario also needs its trainee script in test_academy.py (SCENARIO_SCRIPTS, AC31 runs it on the real simulator).
title_el: Κολυμβητής / καγιάκ κοντά στην παραλία (χωρίς AIS)
title_en: Swimmer / kayak near the beach (no AIS)
intro_el: Ταξιδεύετε σε HDG LOCK κοντά σε παραλία. Κοιτάξτε την κάμερα μπροστά.
intro_en: You are travelling in HDG LOCK near a beach. Watch the forward camera.

prep.do_el: Με το joystick στο κέντρο, πατήστε HDG LOCK στον πίνακα.
prep.do_en: With the joystick centred, press HDG LOCK on the panel.
prep.hint_el: Το κουμπί HDG LOCK είναι στον πίνακα κουμπιών.
prep.hint_en: HDG LOCK is on the panel buttons.

prep.do_el: Σπρώξτε το joystick μπροστά (επιλέξτε «Κράτημα joystick») και κρατήστε το: το σκάφος επιταχύνει.
prep.do_en: Push the joystick forward (tick "Hold the stick") and keep it there: the boat speeds up.
prep.hint_el: Το γκάζι είναι ο άξονας Y (πάνω). Στο HDG LOCK η πορεία μένει στο σύστημα.
prep.hint_en: The throttle is the Y axis (up). In HDG LOCK the course stays with the system.

right_el: Νεκρό αμέσως (STANDBY) και μετά απομακρυνθείτε αργά. Κοντά σε παραλίες: αργά και συνεχής επιτήρηση.
right_en: Neutral at once (STANDBY), then move away slowly. Near beaches: slow and a constant lookout.
debrief_el: Κολυμβητές, καγιάκ και μικρά σκάφη ΔΕΝ έχουν AIS: δεν εμφανίζονται στη λίστα AIS και δεν βγάζουν COLLISION RISK. Η ανίχνευση εμποδίων της κάμερας είναι μόνο βοήθεια (μπορεί μόνο να κόψει ταχύτητα σε AUTO). Τα μάτια σας είναι η άμυνα.
debrief_en: Swimmers, kayaks and small craft have NO AIS: they are not on the AIS list and raise no COLLISION RISK. The camera's obstacle detection is only an aid (it may only slow down in AUTO). Your eyes are the defence.
